newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Volkswagen stand collapses at Brazil auto show.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen stand collapses at Brazil auto show.

text.p: A Volkswagen media event in Brazil turned into a public relations disaster on Thursday when a platform holding 80 journalists and company officials collapsed on a new car the automaker was promoting.
Police said the nine-foot-high (2.8-metre) steel and glass structure gave way in the middle of a news conference at the Sao Paulo Auto Salon, a major car show.
They said at least 30 people suffered minor injuries including a journalist who broke a leg.

"It was one hell of a crash. People and chairs began falling upon one another and several journalists were hurt by the splintered glass," Valeria Baracat, a journalist who attended the news conference, told Reuters.
A Volkswagen Polo car parked underneath the platform was destroyed. The company plans to launch the model in Brazil next year.
The accident forced officials to close the show and clear out all visitors for at least two hours. Volkswagen officials said the company's stand was expected to reopen on Friday.
